==English==
{{wikidata lexeme|L35}}

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*peth₂-}}
Recorded in {{inh|en|enm|-}} since 1422 (as {{m|enm|expanden}}, {{m|enm|expaunden}}), from {{der|en|xno|espaundre}}, from {{der|en|la|expandō|t=to spread out}}, itself from {{m|la|ex-||out, outwards}} + {{m|la|pandō||to spread}}. {{doublet|en|spawn}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{rhymes|en|ænd|s=2}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɪkˈspænd/|/ɛkˈspænd/}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-expand.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[change]] (something) from a [[smaller]] [[form]] or [[size]] to a [[larger]] one; to spread out or lay open.
#: {{ux|en|You can '''expand''' this compact umbrella to cover a large table.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[increase]] the [[extent]], [[number]], [[volume]] or [[scope]] of (something).
#: {{ux|en|A flower '''expands''' its leaves.}}
#* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|book=1|passage=Then with '''expanded''' wings he steers his flight.|year=1873}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=1961-10|title=The winter timetables of British Railways: Scottish Region|journal=Trains Illustrated|page=594|text=This has evidently been encouraging, for the current winter timetable - not even with the benefit of summer holiday traffic - shows that the two trains each way have been '''expanded''' to four.}}
#* {{RQ:Times|author=Tom Whipple|title=Microcannon firing nanobullets: the future of targeted medicine|url=https://www.thetimes.com/uk/science/article/microcannon-firing-nanobullets-the-future-of-targeted-medicine-h8nhjsbd2nd|date=2016-02-01|passage=When an ultrasonic beam is fired at the microcannons, the emulsion evaporates, '''expanding''' rapidly into gas. This creates enough force to push the nanobullets out at velocities reaching several metres per second.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260101063029/https://www.thetimes.com/uk/science/article/microcannon-firing-nanobullets-the-future-of-targeted-medicine-h8nhjsbd2nd|archivedate=1 January 2026}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To express (something) at [[length]] and/or in [[detail]].
# {{lb|en|math}} To rewrite (an expression) or be rewritten as a more [[verbose]], but equivalent, form:
## {{lb|en|transitive|algebra}} To [[rewrite]] (an expression) as a longer, yet [[equivalent]], sum of terms.
##: {{ux|en|Use the binomial theorem to '''expand''' <math>{(x+1)}^4</math>.}}
## {{lb|en|intransitive|algebra|of an expression}} To become, by [[rewrite|rewriting]], a longer, yet [[equivalent]], sum of terms.
##: {{ux|en|The expression <math>{(x+1)}^4</math> '''expands''' to <math>x^4 + 4x^3 + 6x^2 + 4x + 1</math>.}}
## {{lb|en|transitive|arithmetic}} To [[multiply]] both the [[numerator]] and the [[denominator]] of a [[fraction]] by the same (non-zero) [[number]] (which yields a fraction of equal value).
##: {{uxi|en|'''Expanding''' <math>4/7</math> by <math>3</math> gives <math>12/21</math>.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To change or grow from smaller to larger in form, number, or size.
#: {{ux|en|Many materials '''expand''' when heated.}}
#: {{ux|en|This compact umbrella '''expands''' to cover a large table.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[increase]] in extent, number, volume or scope.
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[speak]] or [[write]] [[at length]] or [[in detail]].
#: {{ux|en|He '''expanded''' on his plans for the business.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1899|author=w:Stephen Crane| title=s:Twelve O'Clock|chapter=1| passage=There was some laughter, and Roddle was left free to '''expand''' his ideas on the periodic visits of cowboys to the town. “Mason Rickets, he had ten big punkins a-sittin' in front of his store, an' them fellers from the Upside-down-F ranch shot 'em up {{...}}”}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To feel [[generous]] or [[optimistic]].
# {{lb|en|transitive|computing}} In a [[hierarchical]] [[list]] (such as a [[directory]] tree or [[table of contents]]), to [[show]] the subentries of (an [[entry]]).
#: {{ant|en|collapse}}

====Conjugation====
{{en-conj|old=1}}

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|to change from a smaller form/size to a larger one}} open out, [[spread]], [[spread out]], [[unfold]]
* {{sense|to increase the extent, number, volume or scope of}} {{l|en|enlarge}}
* {{sense|to express at length or in detail}} {{l|en|elaborate}} (on), expand on

====Antonyms====
* {{antsense|to change from a smaller form/size to a larger one}} {{l|en|contract#Verb}}
* {{antsense|to increase the extent, number, volume or scope of}} {{l|en|contract#Verb}}, {{l|en|limit#Verb}}
* {{sense|to express at length or in detail}} {{l|en|limit#Verb}}
* {{antsense|algebra: to rewrite as an equivalent sum of terms}} {{l|en|factor}}
